# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately to `whallysson.dev@gmail.com`. Do not open a public issue for an undisclosed vulnerability.

Include the affected versions and platforms, reproducible steps or a proof of concept, the expected impact, and any suggested remediation.

The maintainer will coordinate validation, remediation, release, credit, and disclosure with the reporter. Keep the report and technical details private until a fixed release is available or a disclosure date is agreed.
